method: Manual policy-preserving repair expectations before repaired evaluation

cases.name: baseline
cases.teacher_interpretation: Within the declared exercise tolerances.
cases.rationale: All pitches are in range and in the sounding score; velocities are within +/-8 of mf/f. Staccato 200 <= 375 ms and tenuto 400 >= 375 ms; unmarked attacks have no duration constraint. Both chord tones coincide. The pedal press follows the beat-2 attack by 10 ms and snaps to beat 2; the release is at beat 4. All seven specifications should accept.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: wrong_pitch
cases.teacher_interpretation: A notated pitch is replaced.
cases.rationale: C-sharp4 replaces the first C4: nearest score pitch distance is 1, so only pitch-agreement rejects.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: outside_range
cases.teacher_interpretation: The first note is outside an 88-key piano and replaces C4.
cases.rationale: MIDI pitch 20 is below the inclusive [21,108] range and is not a score pitch; both pitch checks reject.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: pedal_press_24ms
cases.teacher_interpretation: Pedal follows the relevant attack within the declared 125 ms tolerance.
cases.rationale: Press is 24 ms after beat 2. At 120 BPM, join.py's span lookup has an effective +/-25 ms (0.05 beat) association window after onset snapping, narrower than RML's +/-125 ms (0.25 beat) test. At 25 ms the computed 2.05 beat is within floating-point epsilon of the inclusive boundary and snaps to 2. Beyond 25 ms spanExplicit is false, so pedal-toggle rejects even within its nominal tolerance. The press still follows notePedal before the first noteoff, so syncopated-pedal accepts.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: missing_note
cases.teacher_interpretation: A required score note is omitted.
cases.rationale: F4 at beat 3 is absent. No score-to-performance coverage obligation is generated. E4 still opens the pedal region and both chord tones remain, so all seven specifications accept.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: duplicate_note
cases.teacher_interpretation: An extra E4 re-attack is inserted.
cases.rationale: E4 is re-attacked at beat 2.9 after its first release. E4 is still in the score's sounding interval; the added attack is unmarked, solo and inside the open pedal region. No uniqueness or one-to-one matching requirement exists, so all seven specifications accept.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: missing_release
cases.teacher_interpretation: Pedal release at the end of the marked region is omitted.
cases.rationale: The pedal press has no release. pedal-toggle cannot finish Toggle=press filler* release and rejects. syncopated-pedal requires the post-attack press but does not require a release.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: pre_attack
cases.teacher_interpretation: Syncopated pedal is activated before the relevant attack.
cases.rationale: The press precedes E4 by 10 ms but snaps to beat 2, so pedal-toggle accepts its boundary association. syncopated-pedal encounters a pedalPress before notePedal and rejects it.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: pedal_all_absent
cases.teacher_interpretation: The entire notated pedal region is omitted.
cases.rationale: Without any CC64 events, pedal-toggle accepts other*. The scored-pedal notes still require a subsequent press in syncopated-pedal, which rejects. Absence is not an error for the toggle-only obligation.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: late_press_300ms
cases.teacher_interpretation: Pedal press is 300 ms late, beyond the declared 125 ms tolerance.
cases.rationale: The 300 ms delayed press precedes E4's noteoff at 1400 ms. syncopated-pedal checks event ordering without a millisecond bound and accepts. The press has no associated span start, so pedal-toggle rejects.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: staccato_375ms
cases.teacher_interpretation: Within the declared exercise tolerances.
cases.rationale: First duration equals 0.75 * its 500 ms next-attack gap. staccatoOk uses <=, including equality at 375 ms.

cases.name: mf_velocity_64
cases.teacher_interpretation: Velocity lies in the declared mf interval.
cases.rationale: First velocity is 64; the mf centre is 71.5 and the RML interval is inclusive [63.5,79.5]. MIDI's integer velocities can test adjacent values but cannot equal the half-integer limits.
cases.expectation_basis: Manual reading of repository RML and join.py before monitor execution; not inferred from observed verdicts.

cases.name: final_marked_note
